products.publisher_summary: A Dark Knight biker, a torturous secret, and a road trip that changes everything.Come along for the emotionally wicked ride in this steamy, pulse-pounding small-town standalone romance. No cheating, no cliffhangers, and a happily ever after that will stay with you long after you read the last page.Tattooist Aria Bad has mastered the art of hiding in plain sight. Her art is her only safe place. Crowded rooms make her panic. Peoples eyes burn too hot. Except his. Zeke Wicked has been the steady presence shes leaned on since he tutored her through high school. Hes a loyal, protective Dark Knight biker, the kind of man who sees everything and the one man who could unravel her without even trying. Every year he takes her to see her family for the holidays, but this year shes harboring a secret and needs to go alone.Years ago, Zeke swore to protect, and never touch, Aria, but that didnt stop his heart from staking claim to her. Lately shes been secretive and has been pulling away, and now shes determined to make their annual trip without him, but his instincts wont let her go alone. When a storm strands them, boundaries blur and buried feelings rise to the surface, unearthing a passion neither can deny. But as the storm clears, they discover two dangerous truthsone that ties them together and one that threatens to tear them apart.Tropes: Small-town, found family, biker romance, close proximity, protective hero, savior hero, friends to lovers.About The Wickeds: Dark Knights at BaysideSet on the sandy shores of Cape Cod, the Wickeds feature fiercely protective heroes, strong heroines, and unbreakable family bonds. If you think bikers are all the same, you havent met the Dark Knights. The Dark Knights are a motorcycle club, not a gang. Their members stick together like family and will stop at nothing to keep their communities safe. These men are wickedly alpha and intensely loyal, but they are not alphaholes.

products.merchandising_summary: Lady Georgiana Rannoch never expected to be more than a guest at the coronation of King Edward VIII but murder and some international intrigue make for a change of plans…
products.publisher_summary:
Lady Georgiana Rannoch never expected to be more than a guest at the coronation of King Edward VIII but murder and some international intrigue make for a change of plans…

One of the most daunting things about being related to the royal family but not being royalty myself is finding just the right ensemble for incredibly important events like the coronation. The process has become especially difficult as my maid has fallen ill and I am now relying on Queenie for everything—well almost everything. We do have a lovely new nanny with whom my son James is quite smitten.

My concerns about gowns and Queenie-related disasters are put aside when I receive a worrisome letter from my mother. She seems anxious to see me and is missing her grandson—not at all like her! Darcy and I read between the lines only to discover a coded plea for help. We decide the best way to get Mummy away from Hitler and his cronies is to secure her an invitation to the coronation and have her stay at Eynsleigh along with our other guests for the big event.

Two complications quickly arise. A stern member of the German government has arrived with Mummy who seems to be watching her—and our—every move. And then I unexpectedly find myself involved in the coronation ceremony at Westminster Abbey.

Well, that solves my worry about what I should wear as I will be outfitted by Buckingham Palace for the festivities. But with a house full of visitors for the big event, Darcy receives word that the ceremony itself, and all of the royal attendees are under threat. And to make matters immeasurably worse, one of my esteemed house guests is found quite dead in their bed.

Darcy and I must find a killer and prevent a terrible tragedy all while I do my best to avoid any embarrassing mishaps at the coronation, as quite literally, the world will be watching!
products.subtitle: Royal Spyness, Book 20

products.publisher_summary:
I've always kept my head on straight.

I'm smart, popular, obviously super hot, and the bro my friends can rely on. But under all that, I have a craving I never knew existed: I want to be used. I want to shut my brain off completely and let someone else dictate exactly what I am. I never expected that a stupid challenge during a drunken game with my roommates would be the thing that made me discover a side of myself that doesn't want to think, or speak, or even be human. Now, there's no turning back. My roommates know exactly what I need, and they won't hold back until I'm nothing but their perfect, mindless doll.

Bro Doll is the fourth book of the Kinky ABC Anthology, a collection of standalone stories where each letter explores a different kink. In this book, 'D' is for Dollification.

Each book can be enjoyed on its own.

This story is intended for a mature audience.
